titles: "미국이 만든 배터리 2개" 하나는 중국이, 하나는 결국 LG가 붙잡은 진짜 이유
"GM이 한 번 놓친 배터리" 13년 뒤 결국 LG를 찾아간 진짜 이유
파산한 미국 배터리는 중국 1위로… 망간 배터리는 LG가 붙잡은 진짜 이유
thumbnail_texts: "미국이 만든 배터리 2개" / 하나는 중국, 하나는 LG로
"GM이 한 번 놓친 배터리" / 망간 배터리, 결국 LG로
"파산한 미국 배터리 회사" / 망간 배터리는 LG가 붙잡았다

image_concepts.A: 중국산 배터리 셀이 들어오는 항구의 작은 미국 전기차(1/3) vs 테네시 공장의 밝은 한국 엔지니어와 각형 망간 배터리 셀(2/3)
image_concepts.B: 두 배터리 셀 실물 클로즈업 — 철 배터리(작게·주황 그늘) vs 망간 배터리(크게·파랑 빛) + 엔지니어 1명

thumbnails.concept_ko: 1번(추천·훅 장면). 한국 주인공 대비. 왼쪽 1/3은 항구에서 중국산 배터리 셀 상자가 컨테이너째 내려져 작은 미국 전기차 옆에 쌓이는 장면(차갑고 흐린 톤, 로고 없음). 오른쪽 2/3은 테네시 배터리 공장 — 망간 배터리 셀을 들어 보이며 웃는 한국 엔지니어 3명, 위쪽에 크게 휘날리는 태극기, 황금 역광.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic epic cinematic split scene with a diagonal boundary: on the left third, a grey cargo port where crates of imported lithium iron phosphate battery cells are unloaded from a shipping container and stacked next to a small compact American electric hatchback with no logos, cold desaturated blue-gray tones, overcast light, scratched weathered metal; on the right two thirds, a bright modern battery cell plant in Spring Hill, Tennessee, where three confident smiling Korean battery engineers in clean-room suits hold up a large glowing prismatic manganese-rich battery cell toward the camera in a heroic low-angle shot. A huge Korean flag Taegukgi waves proudly in sunlight in the upper right above the engineers, with golden backlight, glowing rim light, lens flare and sparks on the Korean side. Gritty high-clarity HDR photo, heavy micro-contrast and sharpening, visible film grain and fine noise, crisp detailed textures on metal and glass, dust particles in the air, bright high-key daylight exposure with lifted shadows showing full detail, vivid saturated colors, split color accents of bright electric blue versus warm glowing orange, slightly over-processed look, triumphant and victorious mood.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 한 장면 대비. 같은 공장 바닥 한 장면 — 앞쪽 왼편에 먼지 쌓인 2012년식 미국 배터리 셀 상자와 꺼진 기계, 오른편 뒤로 불이 환하게 켜진 새 망간 배터리 라인과 한국 엔지니어 2명. 문구를 가려도 「꺼진 라인 옆에 왜 새 라인이?」가 생기는 구도.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic cinematic wide shot of a single battery factory floor showing a dramatic contrast in one scene: in the left foreground, dusty abandoned 2012-era American battery cell crates and a switched-off assembly machine under dim cold light with rust and scratches; in the right background, a brand-new brightly lit manganese-rich prismatic battery cell production line glowing electric blue, with two confident Korean engineers in clean-room suits inspecting a cell and smiling. Golden sunlight streams through high windows onto the new line, a medium-size Korean flag hangs on the far wall. Gritty high-clarity HDR photo, heavy micro-contrast and sharpening, visible film grain and fine noise, crisp detailed textures on metal and glass, dust particles in the air, bright high-key daylight exposure with lifted shadows, vivid saturated colors, electric blue versus warm orange accents, slightly over-processed look.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 변형(한 장면 대비). 2012년 미국 발표 무대 — 무대 위 스포트라이트를 받는 기록 배터리 셀은 금이 가며 빛이 꺼지고(왼쪽), 오른쪽에서 한국 엔지니어가 같은 모양의 새 셀을 환하게 빛나게 들어 올린다. 무대 뒤 스크린은 글자 없음.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic cinematic scene of a conference stage in Washington: on the left, a record-setting lithium-ion battery cell on a glass pedestal under a fading spotlight, its glow flickering out with fine cracks across its casing, cool desaturated tones; on the right and larger in the foreground, a confident Korean battery engineer in a clean-room suit raises an identical-shaped prismatic manganese-rich battery cell that glows bright electric blue with golden rim light, smiling proudly in a heroic low-angle shot. Empty audience seats fade into the background, a Korean flag glows softly behind the engineer. Gritty high-clarity HDR photo, heavy micro-contrast and sharpening, visible film grain and fine noise, crisp detailed textures, dust particles in the air, bright high-key exposure with lifted shadows, vivid saturated colors, electric blue versus warm orange accents, slightly over-processed look.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 실물 클로즈업. 두 각형 배터리 셀을 나란히 — 왼쪽 작은 철(LFP) 셀은 주황 그늘, 오른쪽 큰 망간 셀은 파랑 빛으로 화면 절반 이상. 그 뒤에서 셀을 가리키는 한국 엔지니어 1명(놀라움과 자신감).
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic extreme close-up product shot of two prismatic electric vehicle battery cells standing side by side on a scratched steel workbench: on the left, a smaller lithium iron phosphate cell in warm orange shadow; on the right, a much larger manganese-rich battery cell filling more than half of the frame, glowing with bright electric blue light and golden rim light. Behind them, a confident Korean battery engineer in a lab coat leans in and points at the manganese cell with an exaggerated excited expression. Gritty high-clarity HDR photo, heavy micro-contrast and sharpening, visible film grain and fine noise, crisp detailed textures on metal, dust particles in the air, bright high-key daylight exposure, vivid saturated colors, electric blue versus warm orange accents, slightly over-processed look.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 와일드카드(실물 단면형). 거대한 전기 픽업트럭 바닥을 잘라 낸 단면 — 바닥에 촘촘히 깔린 각형 망간 배터리 셀이 파랗게 빛나고, 옆에 셀을 점검하는 한국 엔지니어 1명. 트럭은 GM 계열 실루엣(로고 없음).
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic detailed cutaway cross-section view of a large American full-size electric pickup truck revealing the interior of its floor battery pack, rows of prismatic manganese-rich battery cells glowing bright electric blue packed tightly inside, no brand logos. A confident smiling Korean battery engineer in a clean-room suit kneels beside the truck holding one cell for inspection in a heroic low-angle shot, golden backlight and lens flare behind him. Gritty high-clarity HDR photo, heavy micro-contrast and sharpening, visible film grain and fine noise, crisp detailed textures on metal and glass, dust particles in the air, bright high-key daylight exposure with lifted shadows, vivid saturated colors, electric blue versus warm orange accents, slightly over-processed look.
